description: Rail is a dataset listed in UK national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Ordnance Survey. Features related to travel by railway or tramway. Features representing, describing or limiting the extents of railways. The Transport Features Collection contains information relating to permanent railways that form the network between two points. Coverage: United Kingdom. The portal files it under the publisher Ordnance Survey. The portal shows 2024-12-20 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support rail network and station studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-uk-portal.
